properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Operational net/ scripts (colo-provider, ec2-provider, colo-utils, common.sh, create-solana-user) open ssh sessions to cluster instances with StrictHostKeyChecking=no and UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null, disabling SSH host-key authentication — a real MITM posture finding on the cluster management channel.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha1 crate declared in Cargo.lock — the build ships a SHA-1 implementation (weak, collision-broken, quantum-vulnerable). Dependency-inventory entry: presence is the fact; the consumer in this workspace is tooling, not consensus crypto.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: libsecp256k1 0.6.0 is a first-class crypto dependency of this codebase: the chain exposes secp256k1 ECDSA public-key recovery as a builtin program/syscall (cost constants, program IDs, signature counting in cost-model), and the library implements the curve arithmetic. Quantum-vulnerable elliptic-curve crypto (Shor). Sites span Cargo manifests, cost tables, program IDs and verify call paths.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Non-constant-time ==/!= comparisons of hash values (account hash integrity checks in accounts-db, benchmarks). These compare recomputed vs stored hashes on internal data, not secret MAC tags; the timing exposure is minimal, but the pattern is real and recorded as a posture note.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The real asset at this object's sole genuine site is the aes-gcm-siv 0.10.3 AEAD dependency (Cargo.toml:140); the static-IV classification was a misread of the crate name — AES-GCM-SIV derives its nonces, it is the misuse-resistant variant. Kept in the inventory as an AEAD.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA implementation shipped to the docs toolchain via an npm dependency recorded in docs/package-lock.json (node-forge & co. provide RSA). Available in the shipped dependency tree; no application call site — presence is the inventory fact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ed25519-dalek 1.0.1 (+ ed25519-dalek-bip32 0.2.0) is the core signature scheme of this blockchain: transaction signature verification (sigverify), keypair derivation (BIP32), the ed25519 builtin verify program, and display helpers. Quantum-vulnerable (Shor breaks Ed25519); migration target ML-DSA-65. Sites span Cargo manifests, key generation/verification code and the ed25519-tests workspace member.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek 3.2.1 — and note Cargo.toml [patch.crates-io] redirects it to the solana-labs fork (github.com/solana-labs/curve25519-dalek.git), a supply-chain-relevant pin. Used for Ed25519 batch signature verification (Edwards points in perf/sigverify), ristretto/Pedersen commitments in zk-token, and priced as curve25519 syscalls in compute_budget. Quantum-vulnerable elliptic-curve crypto.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The 15 sites are all committed ecdsa-sha2-nistp256 SSH public keys in net/scripts/solana-user-authorized_keys.sh (authorized_keys material for the solana user on cluster machines) — one logical asset with the ECDSA object ALG-710f61f0, seen through the curve rule. Public key material, intentionally committed.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ed25519-dalek resolved in Cargo.lock — the dependency inventory backing the workspace's core signature scheme (see ALG-5e08bdf5 for the use surface).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CI bootstrap downloads (rustup installer) via curl --tlsv1.2 — a TLS 1.2 *minimum* floor on an HTTPS tooling download, not a pin; classical key exchange either way, low stakes.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: curve25519-dalek resolved in Cargo.lock — same family as ALG-1138d04b (workspace Cargo.toml pins it to the solana-labs fork).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519/curve25519 resolved in Cargo.lock — dependency inventory entry for the curve25519 family (see ALG-1138d04b).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak256 exposed as a BPF syscall (sol_keccak256, Keccak256Hasher over the keccak crate) plus the SBF C sha implementation — live hash surface for on-chain programs. Keccak-256 (pre-SHA-3 padding) is not broken, but it is the SHA-3-family asset of this codebase; quantum resistance of hashes is not the concern — collision/preimage strength is.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: blake3 1.5.0 is the accounts-hash hash function (accounts_db hashing of pubkeys, accounts_hash accumulation) and a registered BPF syscall (Blake3). Live, heavily-used hash surface.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: zk-keygen generates AES-128 symmetric keys for zk-token authenticated encryption (used with AES-GCM-SIV), with seed-phrase recovery — real key-generation asset; 128-bit key size recorded.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 seed derivation from mnemonic in sdk/src/signer/keypair.rs with PBKDF2_ROUNDS = 2048 (the BIP39 standard count, but far below OWASP's 600k recommendation — weak-ish KDF parameter, CWE-916 candidate) producing a 64-byte seed for the Ed25519 keypair.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: zk-token-sdk authenticated encryption uses AES-128-GCM-SIV (Aes128GcmSiv::new for both encrypt and decrypt) — a misuse-resistant AEAD with 128-bit keys; quantum-relevant only in that symmetric 128-bit is the floor, and HNDL on recorded ciphertexts depends on classical KEM exchange, not this.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHAKE256 XOF (Shake256::default) deriving the Pedersen/Bulletproof range-proof generators in zk-token-sdk — hash-to-curve material for the ZK proof system.
